rotunda_concierge.text: Welcome to the Rotunda. Yes, it is round. Yes, I have heard every joke about it.
It is a 25-storey cylinder about 81 metres tall, finished in 1965. It was built as offices.
It was listed in 2000 so nobody could knock it down, and it became flats in 2008. The lift view is excellent.

rotunda_resident.text: My sofa has a view of the whole city. Also of three cranes and one very confident pigeon.
